U.note: Paint-on-grid mixer with three mix modes and a two-color mixer, but it starts nearly empty, the glyphs are tiny and the panel is crowded.

V.note: Clean two-color ratio mixer with a command prompt and arrow keys, but the ASCII picture is a static pattern and the interaction is fairly modest.

W.note: Pigment bowl with paint and light models and kept mixes, but it opens with an empty bowl and a dim, near-invisible glyph field.

X.note: Simple, polished A/B mixer with a live shaded ASCII swatch, a gradient ramp, model toggle and shortcuts, and it holds up on mobile.

Y.note: Bowl and paint canvas with several models, but the canvas looks half-filled with dots, the page is empty at rest and it overflows on mobile.

Z.note: Pigment pots with paint, light and naive models paint a vivid pre-seeded ASCII grid with smudge and chips, and it is rich, legible and responsive.
